subject: Business Models
title: Mental Health Platforms
description: A quick win: understand Mental Health Platforms.

hook.text: BetterHelp has 4 million users paying $65/week for online therapy. Mental health is now a subscription business.

buildup.text: Mental health platforms offer therapy via text, video, and AI chatbots. Access is instant, not a 3-month wait.

discovery.text: 35% of US adults under 30 use mental health apps. Stigma is declining and digital access is expanding the market.

twist.text: BetterHelp was fined for sharing user health data with advertisers. Privacy in mental health tech is a serious concern.

climax.text: Mental health platforms democratize access but must earn the trust that sensitive health data demands.

punchline.text: 4M users, $65/week. Mental health is accessible but trust is still fragile.

quiz.question: What privacy concern arose with BetterHelp?
options: Sharing user health data with advertisers
